verdict.rationale: AI-driven root-cause analysis is a fair axis for an error-monitoring platform, but the evidence pack never shows BugSnag's own AI analyzing stack traces, breadcrumbs, or commits to propose a root cause. The documented features are rule-based grouping, release correlation, and Correlated Events, all of which leave the analysis to the user. The official MCP server only exposes BugSnag data to external agents; it is not the platform itself producing a root-cause analysis.
